parts.title: The Village by the River
parts.text: Long ago, in a village nestled between green hills, Dev followed an **impulse** to set off on a trek that would take her across three rivers to visit a wise healer. She had **prior** experience walking long distances, having traveled with her grandmother since childhood. Luna, the village elder, gave her a **stout** companion for the road — a steady old dog that never left her side.

parts.title: The Gathering Storm
parts.text: By midday the sky had turned **overcast**, a flat gray lid over the hills, and by evening dark clouds rolled in fast. Luna had taught Dev a **technique** for reading the sky, and it was **valid** — the storm arrived exactly when the signs said it would. Dev watched a farmer spread **fertilizer** across his field before rushing home ahead of the rain. She thought of the **previous** storms she had sheltered through and stayed calm.

parts.title: The Discovery
parts.text: When Dev reached the coast, she saw something that made her gasp — a **whale** breached the surface of the sea not fifty metres away, its huge body crashing back into the water. Beside it, tiny **coral** reefs glowed in shades of orange and pink. A fisherman nearby paused to **quench** his thirst from a clay jar, then bowed his head in thanks, as was the custom of the region. "A **fairy** tale come to life," Diya whispered, appearing at Dev's side.

parts.title: The Lesson
parts.text: Dev and Diya stayed by the shore until the stars came out. Luna had told Dev that the greatest adventures were not measured in miles but in what you noticed along the way. The whale, the coral, the farmer, the storm — all of it had something to teach. Dev walked home that night feeling larger inside than when she had left, carrying a quiet understanding she could not quite put into words but would never forget.

secretPassage.passage: Diya followed a sudden _(1)_ — an urge she could not ignore — and set off across three countries to visit an underwater research station. _(2)_ to leaving, she studied everything she could find about ocean life, reading books from her _(3)_ school that she had kept since third grade. The sky was _(4)_, covered by a thick gray blanket of cloud, though the sea was calm enough for a boat ride. Her _(5)_ friend Luna, a broad and sturdy fisherman's daughter, came along, never leaving her side no matter how far they traveled. Diya brought a jug of spring water to _(6)_ her thirst while she ran an experiment testing how _(7)_ — a special nutrient powder that helps plants grow — affects sea grasses. She had a _(8)_ reason for the study, backed by real science and careful notes. A tiny _(9)_ — an imaginary creature from her childhood stories — seemed to dance in the sparkling waves. Far in the distance, a massive _(10)_ leaped into the air, its huge body crashing back into the sea. Bright orange _(11)_ covered the reef below, looking like an underwater garden. Using a special underwater photography _(12)_ — a skilled method she had practiced for weeks — Diya captured everything perfectly.
